title: Repair the development-supervisor busy-port test after hosted PLAY-04 re-check run failures
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: RUN-20261016-025 observes public GitHub metadata for hosted Foundation run 38946897424 on claude/play-04-opening-fix-audit at 5347cc0: attempt 1 (18:23:01-18:31:17Z) and attempt 2 (18:32:08-18:40:21Z) both failure in 'Run the same isolated local pipeline'. The failed-step output, viewed with gh for diagnosis only (not saved), shows the single failing test tests/foundation/processes.test.mjs 'development supervisor rejects a busy service port and leaves the existing listener intact' timing out at 30,000 ms in both attempts.

Analysis per the Director's instruction. scripts/dev.mjs (pnpm dev) runs the full workspace pnpm build, then starts API/match/worker/web and stops all owned process groups if any child exits unexpectedly. The test occupies API port 3001 and expects exit 1, an intact foreign listener and nothing on 3002/5173 (ADR0002's occupied-port regression). Its 30 s limit was dominated by the supervisor's own rebuild (pnpm test has just built everything): locally build-and-start 20.9 s vs cleanup 45 ms; hosted 21.1/28.0/29.5 s passes, then timeouts. A failed build also exits 1, so the previous test passed without reaching the busy port (shown with a stub pnpm).

tests/foundation/processes.test.mjs only: pipe the supervisor's stdout/stderr and require the API's own 'api foundation startup failed' message; await 'close' (streams closed) and expect [1, null]; require close within 15 s of that message (supervisor limits: SIGTERM, 12 s grace, 1 s after SIGKILL); overall timeout 120 s with a comment explaining that it includes the full build. scripts/dev.mjs and all product code unchanged.

RUN-20261016-026: build-and-start 20.9 s, cleanup 45 ms; with a failing stub pnpm the previous test version passes and the repaired one fails with 'API did not report its busy port'; the repaired test passes normally (child exit 0; receipt clock_changed). RUN027: verify:foundation stopped at 'Stale source fingerprint' because the edit preceded this record (ordering error, preserved). RUN028 runs verify:foundation on the repaired source.

PLAY-04 validation section for the hosted run and repair; dated notes in docs/runbooks/ci.md, ADR0002 and BOOT-01 validation; F-SUPERVISOR description and FEATURES.md row; re-check lines in AGENTS.md/README.md/docs/README.md; handoff.
